turns.q: Can I change the shipping address on an order I just placed?
turns.replyTail: Message from Jen Small: Yes—if you’re a U.S. or Canadian customer and you have an account with us, you can update the shipping address within 1 hour of placing the order (as long as it hasn’t entered processing). 1. Log in to your American Tall Account. 2. Go to your Order Page and log in. 3. Find the recent order and click Edit Order. 4. Select Shipping Address and update your address. If the order has already entered processing (or it’s been more than an hour), you won’t be able to make edits.

turns.q: Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
turns.replyTail:
owered by
Cancel
Message from Jen Small: Yes—if you’re a U.S. or Canadian customer with an account, you can request to cancel within 1 hour of placing the order (as long as it hasn’t entered processing). 1. Go to your American Tall Account. 2. Go to your Order Page and log in. 3. Find the recent order and click Edit Order. 4. Select Request Order Cancellation. 5. Click Cancel Order. If the order has entered the shipping process (or it’s been more than an hour), it can’t be modified or cancelled.

Message from Jen Small: You can update some details directly in your account. 1. Go to your account on our website. 2. Log in, then open the Profile tab. 3. Select Shipping Addresses. 4. Add a new address or edit an existing one, and update/add the phone number associated with that address. For certain updates (like changing the email on your account), I can’t make that change here—if that’s what you need, I can connect you with a human agent.
